name: VSS Grounding
summary:
VSS Grounding brings the grounding sessions of the VSS Grounding app into a calm 3D space, in your own room (pass-through) or in a quiet dark room.

 • 11 guided sessions — Alpha Calm, Theta Deep, Delta Ground, Focus Dot, Beta Focus, Snow Counter, Womb Rest, Tinnitus Relief, Rain & Alpha, Somatic Release and Somatic Movement
 • Breathing orbs, eye-movement and focus exercises rendered as soft 3D lights
 • Binaural beats, pink and brown noise and notched tinnitus sound therapy, with recorded voice guidance
